title: Praveen Kumar: dithered engravings made with Figma shaders
note: Dither inspo. Praveen Kumar (product designer, building @thewaterclay) posted 'More figma shaders magic' on 2026-11-06, quoting his earlier 'design explorations I did with dither'. Four classical engravings turned into single-colour ordered-dither pixels on white: a knight chess piece in violet-blue, a great white shark in black, an archer with a sun disc in sky blue, and blindfolded Justice in ochre. Images are the post's own four.
